study: MedMCQA same-model sampled-response disagreement and selective aggregation
scope: Skill-MoE-derived inference workflow; no heterogeneous recruitment or router-confidence comparisons
local_changes: Uncommitted instrumentation and analysis; hashes below identify analyzed artifacts, not a clean commit.

dataset.external_provenance: Local upstream files and hashes recorded; external benchmark lineage and near-duplicate audit remain limited.

generation.primary_execution: Explicitly set all sampling parameters and record runtime versions and actual checkpoint revision before collection.

compute.cap_includes: All primary allocations, model startup, inference, failed primary attempts and retries; prior smoke jobs excluded.
compute.on_cap: Stop, retain completed records, report incomplete collection. No outcome-dependent subsampling or automatic budget extension.

analysis.parser: Strict explicit final answer outside completed thinking; length finish invalid
analysis.invalid_scoring: Incorrect; invalid draws do not vote
analysis.missing_policy: Exclude incomplete records from paired metrics and report coverage; full primary evaluation requires complete collection
analysis.tie_rule: Earliest valid draw among tied answers
analysis.distinct_expert_sensitivity: First sampled response only; one distinct model makes this a single-draw baseline
analysis.missing_feature_policy: Set disagreement/entropy to zero when undefined and include no_valid_answers indicator

models.single_class_fallback: Constant fit prevalence; report undefined discrimination metrics and do not claim useful calibration

analysis.tolerance_units: absolute accuracy proportion, i.e. 2 percentage points
analysis.threshold_selection: Validation only: maximize skip rate subject to accuracy >= always_aggregate_accuracy - 0.02; tie-break by higher accuracy then larger threshold
analysis.threshold_candidates: Unique validation scores plus always-call and always-bypass endpoints
analysis.call_rule: score > threshold; force aggregation when no valid expert answers
analysis.fallback_policy: Always aggregate if no feasible threshold or fitting is unusable
analysis.raw_disagreement_baseline: Tune separately using the same validation constraint and threshold rule
analysis.random_baseline: Match adaptive call count on each evaluation set, including forced calls; 100 predetermined seeds 0..99, no outcome-based selection
analysis.held_out_rule: Freeze models, thresholds and code before inspecting held-out outcomes; evaluate once and report violations without retuning
analysis.cost_claim: Replay aggregator call savings; expert generation is always charged. Generation timings exclude model loading.
analysis.uncertainty: Report 95% paired question bootstrap intervals with 2000 resamples, seed 0; tolerance is an empirical constraint, not a noninferiority guarantee
